description: A class that extends `React.Component` and implements `render()`. Still supported in React 19, but not recommended for new code.
Schedules a state update and **shallowly merges** the object into `this.state`. Updates are batched and asynchronous.
`setState((prev, props) => next)` computes the next state from the latest pending state, so several updates in a row compose correctly.
Class methods lose `this` when passed as callbacks. Bind in the constructor or declare them as arrow class fields.
Default values for missing props. Still supported on classes; removed for function components in React 19.
